title: The Will of the Tianji Record
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought he had understood everything, a sigh echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record—a sound he never expected to hear again, from someone he believed had long been dead.

text.content: The rumbling from the depths of the ruins still echoed in his ears. Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest—the Tianji Record Fragment was vibrating violently, as if something was awakening from slumber.

dialogue.content: You again? Nothing good ever comes when you appear. Last time you made me foresee the Demonic Path Saintess, and it cost me thirty points of Heavenly Fate. Speak, what price must I pay this time?

text.content: However, this time what awaited him was not the aged voice of Mo Xiansheng, but a strange and ancient presence—cold, profound, yet carrying an inexplicable sense of intimacy, as if it had been connected to his bloodline since time immemorial.

【I have waited for you, for far too long.】The voice did not originate from the surface of the fragment, but resonated directly within his Mental Sea, like the lingering resonance of an ancient bell spanning millennia, reverberating in circles.

dialogue.content: (Inner alarm bells ringing) Who are you? Are you the true form of the Tianji Record? No, that cannot be right—Mo Xiansheng told me the Tianji Record is merely a tool, incapable of autonomous consciousness...

text.content: 【A tool? Heh heh...】The voice carried a hint of bitter amusement,【Do you truly believe what that old fool said? He simply wanted you to remain content as a piece on his board.】

Deep within the ruins, golden light began to coalesce. Chen Ji felt the fragment in his hand suddenly become searingly hot, and the familiar characters of the Tianji Record manifested on their own—this time, they were not vague prophecies, but clear lines of ancient seal script.

【Your mother, the last Heavenly Fate Bearer of the Chen lineage—she awakened me from slumber, and before her death, bound you to me. For thirty years, I have watched you grow from a worthless servant into a chess master who leaves nothing to chance, yet I could never truly communicate with you.】

dialogue.content: My mother... (Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly—a rare display of emotion) You knew her? Tell me, how did she really die?

text.content: 【She did not die of illness, nor was it from the schemes of those old fools of the Tianqing Sect.】The Will of the Tianji Record paused momentarily, as if weighing its words,【She voluntarily burned through all her Heavenly Fate to seal away the one who was about to awaken—】

Just then, hurried footsteps echoed from outside the ruins. Chen Ji immediately gathered his focus. He knew that regardless of whether the Will of the Tianji Record spoke truth or falsehood, this place was not one to linger—Ling Yuan's people could arrive at any moment.

【You need not decide now.】The voice suddenly grew gentle,【But I can tell you this: the Key of Fate upon your sister Chen Nian is no coincidence. She is the final move your mother left for you, and the key to breaking the deadlock.】

choice.prompt: The Will of the Tianji Record displayed unprecedented sincerity, but after all, it was merely a tool—Chen Ji, are you willing to trust this sudden 'companion'?

choices.description: Since my mother chose to entrust the Tianji Record to me, it is my companion, not a tool.
choices.visible_cost: Lose Control Over the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Unlock 'Will Resonance' Skill, Heavenly Fate Consumption Reduced by 10%
choices.risk_hint: Once the Tianji Record betrays, all trump cards will be lost

text.content: 【You have made the right choice.】The voice carried satisfaction,【From this day forward, you and I are no longer master and servant, but allies who move pieces together.】
Chen Ji felt a warmth in his chest. The characters on the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly became gentle, no longer cold prophecies but guidance carrying warmth.

choices.memory_label: 与天机录建立平等契约

choices.description: Even a relic of one's mother must not be trusted before full verification—this is his way of survival.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Opportunity for Deep Cooperation with the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining independent judgment, the Tianji Record cannot actively read his thoughts.

text.content: 【Interesting.】 The voice carried no irritation, 【You truly are her son—identical to her in this wariness.】
The script of the Tianji Record dimmed slightly but did not vanish. It continued waiting, waiting for the day Chen Ji would make his own choice.

choices.memory_label: 对天机录意志保持警惕

text.content: Footsteps outside the ruins drew closer. Chen Ji cast a swift glance around, tucking the Tianji Record Fragment into his chest. Just then, a line of golden script materialized on the wall—information only he could perceive.
【Thirty zhang to the northwest lies a hidden passage leading outside the ruins. But I must warn you: Ling Yuan has already set a net of heaven and earth there. He's not waiting for us, but for—】

dialogue.content: He's waiting for me? (A cold sneer) This old fox, he must have been coveting the Tianji Record all along. Thirty zhang... time to take a gamble.

text.content: Chen Ji vanished into the shadows. His steps were silent, yet each footfall precisely landed on safe nodes—this survival instinct honed from years of existing in the gaps between sect powers, also a byproduct of the Tianji Record's foresight ability.

【Three zhang ahead, two spiritual sense scans.】 The Tianji Record's will proactively provided information, no longer passively awaiting queries, 【The left one's cultivation is lower; you can draw their attention away. The right one is Ling Yuan's personal disciple, already at Golden Core middle stage.】

dialogue.content: Golden Core middle stage? (Furrowing brows) Ling Yuan has truly spared no expense... Yet being a personal disciple, he must know many intriguing secrets. Like why his master is willing to obtain the Tianji Record at any cost?

choice.prompt: A Golden Core middle stage personal disciple of Ling Yuan blocked the path ahead. Chen Ji had to make a choice—risk a direct assault, or find another way.

choices.description: With his current Foundation Building initial stage cultivation, facing a Golden Core middle stage was like an egg striking a rock—yet sometimes, desperate situations could unleash true hidden cards.
choices.visible_reward: Shock Ling Yuan, obtain crucial intelligence
choices.risk_hint: If failed, will completely expose location

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, mobilizing his internal spiritual energy. His aura suddenly surged, leaping directly from Foundation Building initial stage to Foundation Building peak—this was the first time he displayed his true cultivation before an enemy.
The personal disciple whirled around, face filled with disbelief: "You're... aren't you atrash?"

choices.description: Brute force was never his preference. Using slight tactics to make the opponent reveal their weakness—this was Chen Ji's style.
choices.visible_reward: Pass silently, obtain the personal disciple's随身令牌
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, will be caught between front and back attacks

text.content: 【A mechanism trap exists in the northwest corner. If you can lead him there...】 The Tianji Record's will proactively suggested a clever plan, 【Given his arrogance, he'll surely fall into it.】

Chen Ji's lips curved slightly as he flicked his finger, launching an ordinary spirit stone—the personal disciple's attention was instantly drawn, his body lunging after it, unaware that the mechanism beneath his feet had silently activated.

The screaming of the personal disciple echoed through the ruins. Chen Ji had already seized the opportunity to sweep past him, casually taking the token from his waist. This token was completely black, bearing Ling Yuan's private mark engraved on it—it would certainly prove useful in the future.
【Well done.】 The will of the Tianji Record carried a hint of praise, 【You are more composed than your father, more cautious than your mother—this is an advantage, but sometimes also a disadvantage.】

dialogue.content: My father? (Chen Ji's footsteps halted) I have never seen him, and my mother never mentioned him... How much do you know about my family?

text.content: 【Enough to shock you.】 The voice suddenly turned solemn, 【But now is not the time to speak of it. You only need to know one thing—before your mother passed away, she told me a secret about your identity, about the Heavenly Secrets Eye, and about... why you could become the inheritor of the Tianji Record.】
Chen Ji did not press further. He knew that some truths require timing, some answers require payment—and he had always been someone willing to wait.

Passing through the final stone gate, Chen Ji finally stepped out of the ruins. Moonlight fell upon him, bringing a long-missed warmth. Yet he knew that after tonight, everything would change—the Tianji Record was no longer merely a tool, and he was no longer that lonely chess player.

【One last thing.】 The will of the Tianji Record suddenly transmitted an intense fluctuation, 【Your mother said that if you ever truly established a contract with me, I should tell you her final words—】

dialogue.content: (Holding breath) ...Speak.

text.content: 【She said: "Ji'er, do not trust the Heavenly Secrets Eye. But even more so, do not trust—those who appear to stand on your side."】 The will of the Tianji Record paused, 【Including me.】
These words were like a basin of cold water, drenching Chen Ji's heart that had just ignited with hope. He stood beneath the moonlight, motionless for a long time.

choice.prompt: His mother's testament revealed a brutal truth—even allies cannot be completely trusted. Facing this warning, how should Chen Ji deal with this newly established "partnership"?

choices.description: Since Mother said this, there must be profound meaning. Instead of avoiding it, why not directly question the Tianji Record: what exactly has it been hiding?
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record May No Longer Be Candid

text.content: 【You are clever, as clever as she was.】 The will of the Tianji Record fell silent for a long time, 【But some things are not that I do not wish to speak of, but that the timing has not arrived. Do you know why the Heavenly Secrets Eye hunts the prophetic seers through the ages?】
Chen Ji shook his head, a chill rising in his heart. He had never imagined that this game of chess was even larger than he thought.

choices.memory_label: 追问天机录隐瞒的真相

choices.description: Some answers need time, some truths need to be discovered by oneself. What matters most now is improving strength and waiting for the appropriate moment.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily Unable to Obtain Critical Information
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a Good Relationship with the Tianji Record and Gain Steady Support

text.content: 【Thinking this way is excellent.】 The will of the Tianji Record carried a hint of relief, 【Your mother was likewise so patient back then. She spent thirty years laying out her plans, ultimately placing the Key of Destiny into your hands.】

Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing the numerous questions in his heart down to the bottom of his heart. No matter what the Tianji Record was hiding, at least for now, it still stood on his side—that was enough.

Night wind blew, carrying the scent of distant beacon fires. Chen Ji knew the turmoil of the Tianqing Sect was only beginning—Ling Yuan would not let this rest, and the claws of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets could descend at any moment.

[There is something I can tell you.] The will of the Tianji Record suddenly transmitted a warm light, [Your sister Chen Nian is currently imprisoned in the deepest Fate Palace of the Holy Sect. Her identity as a Fate Key is the key to opening a certain door—and behind that door lies the greatest secret of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.]

dialogue.content: (His eyes suddenly turned sharp) Chen Nian... I will definitely rescue her. No matter what the cost.

text.content: [Therefore you must become stronger.] The will of the Tianji Record spoke calmly, [I can help you, but every foresight requires consuming your Heavenly Fate. And your Heavenly Fate... is the last gift your mother left you. Once it's gone, it's gone forever.]

Chen Ji did not answer. He merely gazed quietly at the night sky, his pupils reflecting the scattered starlight. From atrash杂役 to an inner disciple, from being trampled upon to making flawless calculations—he had walked this path for thirty full years.

And now, he was finally no longer alone. The will of the Tianji Record, his mother's遗志 bound by blood, and his sister imprisoned in the Holy Sect—all of this would become his greatest trump card in defying heaven and changing fate.
[The Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to make you a chess piece?] The will of the Tianji Record emitted a low laugh, [Then I shall accompany you in overturning this entire chess game.]

dialogue.content: (A slight smile curved his lips) Interesting. But before that, I need to handle the mess at the Tianqing Sect. That old fox Ling Yuan must already know what happened at the ruins.

text.content: [What do you intend to do?] The will of the Tianji Record asked, [A direct confrontation? Your current strength isn't enough for him to even bother with a finger.]

dialogue.content: Who said anything about direct confrontation? (A light laugh) I only need to let Han Lie know that Ling Yuan intends to sacrifice the Xuanwu Sect in exchange for the Tianji Record—do you think that simple-minded genius will go berserk?

text.content: [Using the enemy to control the enemy... you truly inherited your mother's essence.] The will of the Tianji Record praised, [However, though Han Lie is simple-minded, he's no fool. How do you plan to make him believe?]

dialogue.content: No need to make him fully believe. (Chen Ji took out that pitch-black token from his怀) I only need to plant suspicion. Once suspicion takes root, it grows on its own.

text.content: [Good.] The will of the Tianji Record carried a hint of anticipation, [Then I shall watch with great interest.]

Chen Ji tucked the token back into his怀, his figure flickering and vanishing into the night. What he didn't know was that shortly after his departure, a dark shadow quietly appeared at the ruins' entrance—Ling Yuan's another direct disciple, who had been secretly monitoring everything.

'trash...' the shadow coldly sneered, 'I never expected you to hide such a trump card. But it doesn't matter—Master always said, the deeper a chess piece is hidden, the more valuable it becomes once exposed.'
At the same time, in the secret chamber deep within the Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan slowly opened his eyes. Before him floated an ancient mirror, reflecting Chen Ji's departing silhouette.

dialogue.content: The will of the Tianji Record... finally awakened? (A glint of greed flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes) Interesting—the thing Chen Xuan failed to achieve, his son has accomplished.

text.content: 'Master, news from the ruins—Young Master he...' A disciple rushed in to report, but was waved silent by Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: No need to say more. (Ling Yuan smiled faintly, that smile carrying a hint of admiration) Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, you exceed my expectations even more. However... do you truly believe the Tianji Record is your greatest trump card?

text.content: He gently stroked the ancient mirror before him, its surface suddenly rippling to reflect a blurry figure—that figure bore some resemblance to Chen Ji, yet was more mature, and more... dangerous.

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan, you indeed left a backup plan. (Ling Yuan's voice was low and icy) Unfortunately, your son is still too green. The moment he uses the Tianji Record for foresight... will be his death.

text.content: The instant Ling Yuan's words fell, Chen Ji, hundreds of miles away, suddenly felt a sharp pain in his chest—the Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled and emitted a blinding golden light.

dialogue.content: (Frowning) What's wrong?

text.content: [Someone is tracking us.] The will of the Tianji Record spoke with grave solemnity, [It's Ling Yuan's Karma Mirror—an ancient artifact that can lock onto all people and objects connected to the target through causality.]

dialogue.content: (A cold smile) Karma Mirror? Interesting. It seems this old fox Ling Yuan is more impatient than I imagined.

text.content: "There is one more thing you must know." The will of the Tianji Record suddenly transmitted an intense warning, "The Causation Mirror not only tracks, it can... pollute foresight. When you use the Tianji Record, it can implant false information into your foresight visions."
Chen Ji's footsteps came to an abrupt halt. Polluted foresight—this meant his greatest trump card upon which he relied for survival might no longer be reliable from this moment onward.

dialogue.content: "Is there a way to break it?" (His voice was steady, betraying no panic.)

text.content: "There is." The will of the Tianji Record spoke with solemn gravity, "But the cost is great—you need to expend an additional thirty percent of your Heavenly Fate during foresight to construct a causation barrier, blocking the Causation Mirror's pollution."

Thirty percent... Chen Ji calculated silently. With his current Heavenly Fate, every use of foresight required meticulous planning, and adding this thirty percent would drastically reduce the number of times he could use it.

dialogue.content: "Forget it, let's not think about this for now." (Chen Ji raised his head to gaze into the distance.) "The priority is to return to the Tianqing Sect and set up a situation before Ling Yuan makes his move. And your awakening... can正好 serve as a new trump card."

text.content: "What do you plan to do?" The will of the Tianji Record asked, "Reveal my existence publicly? Or continue to hide?"

Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He closed his eyes, countless possibilities flashing through his mind at lightning speed. Every choice had its pros and cons, every arrangement required a price—and he had always been someone willing to sacrifice immediate interests for long-term gain.

"Hide first." (Chen Ji opened his eyes, a sharp light flickering within his gaze.) "The news of your awakening should be known by as few people as possible. Wait until the critical moment, then reveal it—only then can it exert its greatest effect."
"As you wish." The will of the Tianji Record carried a hint of approval in its tone, "You are more suited to be a chess player than I imagined."

A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, but he did not respond to this praise. He knew very well that no matter how skilled a chess player, they are merely a chess piece—the true chess player is the one seated at a higher elevation.
"The Eye of Heavenly Secrets..." (Chen Ji murmured softly) "What do you really want? What did my mother seal away on her deathbed?"

"These questions, I cannot answer for now." The will of the Tianji Record fell silent for a moment, "But one thing I can be certain of—everything your mother did was to give you, one day, the ability to confront the Eye of Heavenly Secrets directly."
"Confront directly..." (Chen Ji let out a soft laugh) "I'm still far from that. But it doesn't matter, there's still time. A chess piece can gradually become a chess player."

Under the moonlight, Chen Ji's figure gradually faded into the distance. What he did not know was that in the direction he departed, a white-clothed figure stood motionless on the treetop—it was Su Qingyao.
"Chen Ji..." Su Qingyao gazed at that increasingly distant figure, a complex light flickering in her eyes, "How many secrets are you still hiding?"

She did not pursue him. She knew that some things, when pushed too hard, would only backfire. But she had made a firm decision—next time, she would definitely uncover the true face of this "waste" junior brother.

The night deepened, undercurrents surged. The landscape of the Tianqing Sect was quietly changing, and Chen Ji stood at the center of this storm, weaving an unbreakable chess game that no one could decipher.

The will of the Tianji Record emitted a faint warmth against his chest, as if responding to his determination. In this moment, Chen Ji suddenly felt a strange sensation—he was no longer a solitary chess player, but had finally found a companion to fight alongside.

"Chen Ji." The will of the Tianji Record suddenly transmitted a gentle fluctuation, "There is something I must tell you—about your mother, about why she died, and about... the final gift she left you."

dialogue.content: (His footsteps faltered) "Speak."

text.content: "Your mother did not die from exhausting her Heavenly Fate, but from... saving you. She used her own soul as the price to conceal you from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' gaze, preventing it from directly locating your existence."
Chen Ji's breath hitched slightly. He had never imagined that his mother's death still held such a hidden truth.

"And the final gift she left you is hidden on the fourth page of the Tianji Record." The will of the Tianji Record paused, "That is a memory, a memory only you can unlock—about your origins, about your father, and also about... the true origin of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets."

dialogue.content: (His voice slightly hoarse) "The fourth page... isn't that where Chen Nian's Destiny Lock is located?"

text.content: Destiny Key and Memory Seal are two sides of the same coin. The will of the Tianji Record spoke calmly, Your mother designed everything—when Chen Nian's Destiny Key breaks free from its restraints, that is the moment you unlock the truth.

Chen Ji fell silent. He stood beneath the moonlight, allowing the night wind to stir his robes, yet within his heart churned indescribable emotions. Thirty years of meticulous planning, his mother had paved a path to truth with her life—and he simply needed to follow this road forward.

dialogue.content: (Softly) Mother... I will not disappoint you.

text.content: She has never been disappointed in you. The will of the Tianji Record transmitted a warm light, From the moment you were born, she knew—you would be the key to changing everything.

Chen Ji drew a deep breath and stepped forward again. His silhouette stretched long in the moonlight, yet more resolute than ever before. He understood the path ahead remained distant, his enemies formidable—but fear no longer gripped him.

For he finally comprehended he was not fighting alone. His mother left behind not merely the Tianji Record and Destiny Key, but an unyielding spirit—and this will would sustain him through this against-heaven path.
Just as Chen Ji vanished into the night, the characters on the Tianji Record Fragment flickered subtly—the fourth page's location, where Chen Nian's Destiny Key resonated quietly.
At the same time, deep within the Holy Sect's Heavenly Fate Hall, a young woman bound by chains suddenly opened her eyes. Golden light reflected in her gaze—a sign the Destiny Key was awakening.

dialogue.content: Brother...? (Chen Nian whispered softly) You've finally... come for me...

text.content: A single tear traced down her cheek, quickly devoured by surrounding darkness. Chains clanked, yet could not imprison the fragile yet unwavering hope burning in her heart.
In the distant Void's depths, an invisible gaze silently opened—the true form of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, sensing ripples in destiny, a knowing smile seemingly playing at its lips.
Interesting. The transcending existence murmured deeply, Chen Xuan's son... finally stepping onto the chessboard? Then let me witness how far you can truly go.

Winds surged, heavenly secrets quivered. What Chen Ji remained unaware of was his every movement under that surpassing existence's watchful gaze. Each choice he was about to make would shape the ultimate trajectory of this ten-thousand-year chess game.
Yet at this moment, he knew only one truth—he must grow stronger, rescue his sister, unveil all realities, and make those who treated him as a mere piece pay the price they deserved.

The will of the Tianji Record quivered deeply within the Tianji Record Fragment, as if responding to its master's resolve. From this moment, the grand game formally commenced, and the partnership between Chen Ji and the Tianji Record would inscribe its own chapter in this ten-thousand-year chess match.
